title: Thai-Indian Shrimp Bites
description: A unique fusion of flavors combining the spices of India with the bold taste of Thailand.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together curry paste, Indian spices, and a pinch of salt.
3. Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
4. Place the naan bites on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Spoon a small amount of the shrimp-curry mixture onto each naan bite.
6. Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until the naan is lightly toasted and the shrimp is cooked through.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
